author: paper-design
name: grain-gradient
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Grain Gradient style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#0A0A0A, #3F3CBB, #DB4B8F, #FFD66B). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
